name: onadit
stderr:
Usage: onadit [options] [command]

CLI for the Onadit daemon

Options:
  -V, --version                         output the version number
  --config <path>                       Path to config.json (default:
                                        "/tmp/Library/Application
                                        Support/Rift/data/config.json")
  --json                                Output as JSON (default: false)
  -h, --help                            display help for command

Commands:
  token                                 Token management
  status [options]                      Show daemon status briefing with
                                        friend-readable header
  doctor [options]                      Diagnose Onadit in plain language and
                                        show one next action
  stats                                 Show table statistics
  search [options] [query]              Search across all indexed content
  brief [options]                       Print the prepared project brief for a
                                        directory (default: current directory)
  save [options]                        Save an agent session artifact (summary
                                        + optional transcript)
  import [options] <file>               Import a conversation export
                                        (ChatGPT/Claude/Grok zip, or Gemini
                                        JSON)
  ingest [options]                      Import a conversation export (zip or
                                        JSON)
  compact [options]                     Trigger compaction cycle or rollback
  reindex [options]                     Rebuild vector indices from raw files
  reconcile [options]                   Verify index completeness and repair
                                        gaps
  rebuild [options]                     Full rebuild of all tables from raw
                                        state
  chunk-backfill [options]              Owner-only: re-chunk historical
                                        conversations from raw (offline; daemon
                                        must be stopped)
  embedding-migrate [options] [action]  Operator: migrate the complete cloud
                                        vector family, preserving local vectors
  bulk-ingest [options]                 Ingest all supported files from a
                                        directory
  capture [options]                     Auto-capture local agent conversations
                                        (Claude Code + Codex; opt-in: Cursor,
                                        Claude desktop/Cowork, Grok CLI)
  cursor-probe [options]                Read-only discovery of native Cursor
                                        composer/chat sessions (no capture)
  review                                Manage the review queue for borderline
                                        conversations
  backfill [options]                    Stage and import web conversation
                                        exports from a batch folder
  originals-backfill                    Keep local originals still on disk for
                                        enabled capture sources (no model calls)
  triage [options]                      Submit a batch of conversation files for
                                        triage
  onboard [options]                     Add an archive, find a memory, connect
                                        your AI tool
  mcp                                   Connect agents to Onadit, or serve its
                                        MCP tools over stdio.
  hooks                                 Manage agent hook integrations for
                                        Onadit.
  feedback [options] [note...]          Send a quick note to Clem (or store it
                                        locally).
  uninstall [options]                   Stop the Onadit daemon, remove its plist
                                        + MCP entries, optionally purge data
